newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar ends barely changed, dull.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar ends barely changed, dull.

text.p: London white sugar futures ended little changed on Thursday in a dull market that found no news to spur activity, traders said.
Dealings were routine in the afternoon with switches and crosses cited in both the December and March contracts.
December last traded up just 10 cents at $318.30 and March was up 30 cents at $315.50.

Volume reached 1,417 lots. European brokers said Libya postponed its deadline for bids in its white sugar buying tender until Friday with replies to be issued sometime on Monday. It has tendered to buy 14,000 tonnes of 45 ICUMSA white sugar for shipment in November/December.
